prompt: Create an original 180 second gamelan-inspired instrumental instrumental composition for mystery, nocturnal exploration and restrained suspense. Mood: mysterious, tense, nocturnal. Instruments: metallophones, soft gong, bamboo flute. Style: cyclic interlocking metallic patterns with long gong punctuation. Tempo approximately 70 BPM; G minor. Main idea: a compact three-note motif. Use unresolved suspended harmony, careful space and subtle low-register movement; no jump scares. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-01:00] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [01:00-02:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [02:00-03:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 03:00.

description.en: A melancholic and reflective instrumental piece that begins with a sparse piano and pizzicato strings, gradually building in emotional depth with sustained strings and a more cinematic feel. It maintains a gentle, flowing rhythm throughout.
description.zh: 一首忧郁而富有沉思感的器乐作品，以稀疏的钢琴和拨弦乐器开场，随后逐渐加入持续的弦乐，情感深度增强，营造出电影般的氛围。整体保持着轻柔流畅的节奏。
